blends: For each of eight representation/architecture outputs, retain its standalone natural probabilities, a fixed 50/50 blend with its matched representation HGB, and a fixed 50/50 blend with the previously frozen deep500_hgb. Both decision policies remain registered and forecast_3600. The eleven saved controls give 35 sources x 3 dates x 2 assets x 2 policies = 420 panels.
encoding: Drop only features constant on training rows. Each active original feature has at most 32 equal-probability training bins with duplicate edges removed. Clip values to that feature training minimum and maximum; interpolate inside its bin. The projected embedding is bias plus the sum of all earlier bin weights plus the fractional current-bin weight. Four embedding coordinates per feature; no parameter sharing across features. This clipped-tail design differs from the unbounded-tail version in the original embedding paper. Knots use no labels or validation/assessment rows.
hypothesis: Learn separate nonlinear numerical feature representations before cross-feature mixing. The existing scalar-input MLP and earlier shared-parameter ensemble did not test quantile piecewise-linear feature embeddings. Fixed shared-member averaging may reduce variance of these richer feature maps.
implementation: Use cumulative bin weights and gather the current bin, avoiding a dense observation-by-feature-by-bin tensor. Test forward values and gradients against a direct dense formulation. Append the asset scalar after embedding and mix features only inside the existing two-layer 64-wide backbone. Eight-member models reuse the existing shared linear weights, member-specific input/output scales and independent output heads.
optimization: Unchanged twelve epochs, AdamW learning rate .001, weight decay .01, gradient clip 5, batch size 1024, seed 20260907 and CPU two threads. Average member cross-entropy losses with equal asset/class training weights. Select once by preceding-noon mean asset balanced accuracy, then natural log loss. No architecture or epoch sweep beyond the four fixed cells.
partitions: Original recent four training days d-5 through d-2 at fixed four-second stride; previous-day noon validation; unchanged 7070 observations per asset/date at current noon. Exact existing fields, labels and timestamps required.
posterior: Recover each member natural probabilities with the true training asset class prior, then average natural member probabilities. With one member this must exactly reproduce the original scalar MLP training/checkpoint predictions. The averaging contract is explicit; do not silently mix averaged weighted posteriors with averaged natural posteriors.

primary_sources.scope: Gorishniy, Rubachev and Babenko study numerical feature embeddings, including quantile-based piecewise-linear encodings. We borrow the mathematical representation, with an explicitly different clipped-tail convention.

Gorishniy, Kotelnikov and Babenko combine shared-parameter MLP ensembles and numerical feature embeddings. Our smaller fixed eight-member architecture is inspired by this approach, not a replication of their tuned benchmark setup.
